messages:
Asha Patel: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands
Leah: thanks for joining, short Q: what's the single most important metric for Q2? unit cost/token, p95 latency, or new-seat ARR?\nLeah Kim: Priority order: 1) reliability & SLAs, 2) unit cost for hosted workloads, 3) PLG activation. Main focus: stabilize SLAs then push unit-cost improvements. OKRs arriving tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Luis Ortega: Practically speaking, should eng teams prioritise Optimize features (batching, quant) or get more Dedicated capacity out sooner?
Leah Kim: Sequence: Optimize -> Dedicated scale -> Private/VPC work. Optimize gives faster margin wins; Dedicated is our enterprise expansion lever.
Tom Nguyen: Messaging question: keep "production-first" vs cloud providers, or tilt to "cost-savvy inference" for infra buyers?
Leah Kim: Keep production-first as umbrella. For infra/platform personas we emphasize cost, deterministic SLOs, and governance. We'll produce two persona one-pager.
Jenny Park: Can we get that one-pager so sales has clear snippets?
Leah Kim: Yes @Jenny  I'll draft in 48h with three archetypes + sample KPIs (p95 target, $/1M tokens, MTTI).
Raj Singh: APAC latency question: SG/JP customers want lower latency. Are SG/JP region rollouts prioritized for Dedicated/private in 2026?
Leah Kim: Hosted regions for SG/JP targeted H2 2026. Dedicated depends on partners; timeline in roadmap next week.
Asha Patel: Clarify "fallbacks": is it model-variant + region failover or more?
Leah Kim: Example: primary rlx-1 in US; fallback rlx-1-q (quantized) in EU. Routing policy: local variant -> remote variant -> lower-cost tier. Diagram to follow.
Luis Ortega: Any Dedicated pricing changes tied to Series C goals?
Leah Kim: No immediate price change. Piloting burst blocks and 3-tier reserved commits next month. Finance will share results.
Tom Nguyen: Will rollout SLAs change release windows for eng teams?
Leah Kim: New rollout guardrails (canary %, auto-fallback) land in June. Eng teams get runbook + changelog.
allhands-bot: Recording + slides: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/1768000123
Jenny Park: I'll add the one-pager to sales enablement and sync with PMM. :thumbsup:
Asha Patel: Thanks, please share OKR doc when live.
Leah Kim: OKR doc + Q&A by EOD tomorrow. Keep questions in follow-up thread.
